cohort: The study included 65 women with pernicious placenta previa who underwent selective cesarean sections between January 2017 and June 2019.
finding: The transverse parallel compression suture method for placenta previa during cesarean section achieved a 93.8% success rate in hemostasis and preserved the uterus in all cases, resulting in significantly lower operation time, ICU stay, and ICU admission rate compared to conventional surgery.
mod_finding: The novel transverse parallel compression suture method was found to be an easy, effective, and safe technique to stop bleeding from the lower uterine segment during cesarean sections for women with placenta previa and accreta.
